title: Children of Nature (Ki Khun Mariang)
cultural_context: Patriotic anthem declaring the spiritual brotherhood and kinship between the Khasi people and mother nature.
lyrics_khasi:
Ngi long ki khun ka Mariang,
Ba san ha pneh u lum,
Ngi sngewthuh ia ka ktien
Jong ki sim bad ki um;
Ki khlaw kiba rben
Ki ai ia ngi ka sem,
Ki mawlynnai ba shai
Ki don ha man ka them.

Ngin sumar ia ka ri,
Ia ki wah bad ki dieng,
Ban ri ia ka spah mariang
Ba ki kpa ki la iehnoh;
Kum ki khun u Hynniewtrep
Ngin ieng ha kawei ka nia,
Ban pynneh ia ka nam
Jong ka Ri ki Blei.
lyrics_english:
We are the children of Nature,
Reared in the lap of mountains,
We understand the language
Of forest birds and running streams;
The dense verdant woods
Offer us shelter and home,
The sparkling jewels of nature
Dwell in every valley.

We shall protect our land,
Our waterways and forests,
To safeguard nature's riches
Bequeathed by our ancestors;
As true progeny of the Seven Huts
We stand on one righteous cause,
To preserve the glorious name
Of our Land of the Gods.
